# THE AMERICAN DECLARATION OF FREEDOM IN SPACE

Proclamations

November 3, 2026

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA

A PROCLAMATION
It is America’s destiny to explore and expand our frontiers beyond Earth to the farthest depths of space.  Today, my Administration reaffirms that our solar system and all of outer space beyond Earth are the province of all humans, and that our Nation will lead the way in the exploration, development, use, and settlement of these new frontiers — forging an interplanetary civilization founded on the enduring and inalienable rights of freedom and individual liberty.
From the intrepid Apollo 11 astronauts who took humanity’s first steps on the Moon to the pioneering rovers that explored the surface of Mars, the United States has always blazed a trail into the great unknown, shattering boundaries and pushing mankind to extraordinary new heights.  Behind each triumph are generations of astronauts, scientists, engineers, and workers whose tireless dedication and unmatched ingenuity turn impossible dreams into reality.
Under my leadership, the United States is once again writing a bold new chapter in space exploration.  This past April, the Artemis II mission successfully carried astronauts around the Moon and farther from Earth than any human had ever traveled before.  This historic voyage is only the beginning.  Next summer, Artemis III will undertake one of the most complex and consequential test flight campaigns in the history of our Nation’s space program.
This proud legacy of innovation is our sacred inheritance, and our Nation bears the solemn responsibility to advance it by continuing to open new horizons of exploration and discovery.  Through the landmark Executive Orders and directives I have signed, we are reinvigorating human spaceflight, unleashing a competitive and thriving commercial space industry, and ensuring American space superiority for all eternity.  We will return to the Moon by 2028, lay the foundation for a permanent American lunar presence, and hasten the day when an American becomes the first human to set foot on the red dunes of Mars.  Together, we will build the facilities, develop the resources, and establish a permanent presence in space to extend the reach of American exploration, preserve our frontier spirit, and strengthen our national security for centuries to come.  The nation that leads in space will shape the future of humanity — and that nation will be the United States of America.
Today, we renew our solemn and righteous mission to propel humanity toward the farthest reaches of the universe.  We reaffirm that the United States will lead the way in this bold endeavor, for the nation with the best scientific understanding of space, the most advanced space economy, and the greatest spacefaring citizens, will be the most prosperous nation for centuries to come.
 Above all, we pledge to carry our sacred values of faith and freedom wherever we journey, so that freedom may forever ring among the stars and beyond.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, DONALD J. TRUMP, President of the United States of America, by virtue of the authority vested in me by the Constitution and the laws of the United States, do hereby proclaim that the solar system and all of outer space beyond Earth are the province of all humans and are open to exploration, development, use, and the establishment of a permanent presence by American citizens consistent with United States law and the international obligations of the United States.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand this third day of November, in the year of our Lord two thousand twenty-six, and of the Independence of the United States of America the two hundred and fifty-first.

                             DONALD J. TRUMP
translation_ja:
米国の宇宙における自由宣言
2026年11月3日。米国大統領による布告。

地球を超え宇宙の最も遠い領域まで探求・開拓することは米国の使命である。本政権は、太陽系と地球外の全宇宙が全人類の領域であり、米国が探査・開発・利用・定住を先導し、自由と個人の自由という永続的で不可侵の権利に基づく惑星間文明を築くと再確認する。

人類初の月面歩行を成し遂げたアポロ11号の宇宙飛行士から火星探査車まで、米国は未知への道を切り開き、限界を破ってきた。その成果の背後には、夢を現実に変える宇宙飛行士、科学者、技術者、労働者の何世代もの献身と創意がある。

私の指導の下、米国は再び宇宙探査の新章を書いている。今年4月のアルテミスIIは飛行士を月周回と人類史上最も地球から遠い地点へ運んだ。この航海は始まりであり、来年夏のアルテミスIIIは米宇宙計画史上、最も複雑で重要な試験飛行計画の一つを実施する。

この革新の遺産を受け継ぎ、探査・発見の地平を開き続ける責任がある。署名した大統領令・指令を通じ、有人宇宙飛行、競争的で繁栄する商業宇宙産業、米国の宇宙優位を推進する。2028年までに月へ戻り、恒久的な米国の月面拠点の基盤を築き、米国人による火星初踏査を早める。施設を建設し、資源を開発し、恒久的存在を確立して探査を広げ、開拓精神と国家安全保障を強める。宇宙を先導する国が人類の未来を形作り、その国は米国である。

人類を宇宙の遠方へ進める使命を新たにし、米国が先導すると再確認する。最良の科学的理解、最先端の宇宙経済、優れた宇宙活動を担う国民を持つ国が、今後何世紀も最も繁栄する。旅の先々に信仰と自由の価値を携え、星々の間とその先でも自由を響かせる。

よって、憲法と米国法により与えられた権限に基づき、太陽系と地球外の全宇宙は全人類の領域であり、米国民が米国法・米国の国際義務に従い探査・開発・利用・恒久的存在を確立するために開かれていると布告する。

西暦2026年11月3日、米国独立251年に署名。ドナルド・J・トランプ。
